name: Mika-chan to! Aka-chan Umanakya Derarenai Shima
original_name: みかちゃんと！あかちゃん産まなきゃ出られない島
source:
Circle Hyoukorarin presents their first fully voiced heroine game.

This is a simulation visual novel game in which you sexually assault Mika Asakura, a girl who has been kidnapped, using every means possible.

This game focuses on pregnancy and childbirth,
with a total of 17 H-scenes, 8 of which depict her in a pregnant state, and multiple childbirth scenes.

In an unending nightmare of being a sex slave, Mika, a girl whose personality is destroyed,
will she be able to reunite with her younger sister, Yuki, who was kidnapped with her?
translation:
Circle Hyoukorarin推出了他们的第一款全配音女主角游戏。

这是一款模拟视觉小说游戏，你使用一切可能的手段对被绑架的女孩朝仓美香进行性侵犯。

该游戏以怀孕和分娩为主题，
共有17个H场景，其中8个是怀孕状态的场景，以及多个分娩场景。

在成为性奴隶的无尽噩梦中，人格被摧毁的女孩米卡，
她能否与一起被绑架的妹妹由希重逢呢？
